description: Department of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources - Minimum Standards for the citizens of Sri Lanka engaged in Fishing Operations in foreign flagged fishing boats.
reasoning: This gazette content consists of regulations made by the Minister under the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, specifically amending minimum standards for Sri Lankan citizens engaged in fishing operations in foreign flagged boats. It establishes legal/regulatory requirements and compliance measures for fishing activities, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves regulatory frameworks and statutory instruments.
